name: PnP Core SDK (PnP .NET)
short_description: Open-source, community-maintained .NET SDK from the Microsoft 365 PnP community that offers a graph-first, fluent API for SharePoint and Teams and handles throttling; it is not supported by Microsoft.

evidence.quote: PMP.NET is an SDK. It's a graph first SDK that is there and it's also fluent wrapper around the graph API.
